prompts.meadow: Use case: precise-object-edit / stylized-concept. Edit target: the game screenshot. Create a visual overlay study, not a redesign of the sprites. Keep the screenshot's camera, road network, UI, exact positions, sizes and shapes of ALL existing characters, buildings, trees, crops, bushes and resource piles. Only replace the terrain and add natural grounding beneath the existing subjects. The other image is a style reference for approved buildings, not an edit target. A QUIET MEADOW: short low grass and velvety moss in muted sage/forest green, small grass blades no taller than one twentieth of a person, no large leafy clumps, no jungle bushes. Smooth broad tonal variation, quiet underlay with enough open ground to see the subjects clearly. Rich soft miniature material lighting from upper left, matching the building stonework, not photographic texture. Give each building a small irregular worn earth apron at its foundation and entrance, soft contact shadow tucked tightly underneath, and feathered grass at the outer apron. Paths physically meet the door/step areas. Rock piles slightly bedded into earth, tree roots anchored in grass, people cast small soft shadows at their feet; no black floating halos, no square bases. Water: calm dark jade pools with small restrained highlights and visible shallow pebbly bank, narrow natural uneven edge lit from upper left; no giant ocean waves. Roads: subdued earth in warm gray-brown, narrow gently worn center with soft grass verges, retain the network layout and read as walking paths at the scale of a person's feet. Preserve all sprite silhouettes and their relative scale. Preserve UI and readable labels. Ground should support rather than compete with the objects. No extra structures or decorative scene props.
prompts.woodland: Use case: precise-object-edit / stylized-concept. Edit target: the game screenshot. Create a second visual overlay study. Preserve camera, UI, road layout, EXACT sprite positions, sizes, shapes and appearance of all existing buildings, Kith, resource groups, trees, bushes and crops. Other image is approved building STYLE reference only. Change only ground and water plus contact grounding. WORN WOODLAND FLOOR: a restrained cool brown-gray earthen base with scattered low moss islands and sparse tiny flattened grass, gentle green-brown transitions, softly modeled miniature surfaces, quiet large shapes, not a flat grainy photograph. Lots of open walking space, avoid lush jungle, broadleaf ground plants, checkerboard and sharp repeating patches. Scale vegetation far smaller than the tree canopy or a person. Build physical connection: irregular earth aprons tucked against building foundations, paths meeting entrances, soft narrow contact shadows under footprints, low moss feathering over rock edges, trees with roots into earth and resource piles seated slightly in soil. Maintain the actual sprite perspective and upper-left light. Roads darkened slightly by foot traffic, embedded small stones, soft verges; read clearly without bright yellow ribbons. Calm deep blue-green water with restrained reflection, a visible rounded damp bank and very small scattered shoreline pebbles; no ocean wave texture or oversized shore rocks. Keep original subjects sharp and recognizable, no floating halos or tile bases. Preserve UI and labels. No additional buildings, objects or characters.
prompts.blended-regions: Use case: compositing. Asset type: visual terrain paintover for Solace, a top-down tile-based miniature settlement game. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: preserve its framing, camera, UI labels, map layout, road topology, river course, buildings, characters, resource piles, crops, tree positions, subject scale and silhouettes. Image 2 is REFERENCE ONLY for woodland ground color/material. Combine both terrain treatments in ONE continuous map. Around the central Hearth, huts and cultivated fields retain the quiet short sage-green meadow of image 1. Beneath existing dense tree groups, especially the grove on the right riverbank and the groups at the top-left and bottom-left, gradually introduce the cooler brown-gray worn woodland floor from image 2: low moss, leaf litter and exposed shaded soil. Show irregular interlocking transition patches over several tile widths, sparse meadow grass in woodland edges and small moss islands in open meadow, no sharp biome boundaries and no rectangular patches. Both banks have a third damp shoreline treatment: darkened soil, small rounded embedded stones, tiny sparse reeds, shallow jade water transitioning to calm deeper teal; reeds and stones must stay much smaller than Kith. Preserve the bridge and gently connect its ends to bank paths. Roads retain their network but inherit local material: pale worn earth in the meadow, darker earth within woodland, damp edges near water. Each building remains seated on an irregular modest worn apron connected to its entrance, with a tight soft contact shadow under its foundation; resources and tree roots embedded into local soil and tiny shadows beneath feet. Match the approved miniature style with soft upper-left light throughout. Vegetation is LOW and quiet, never oversized jungle leaves or noisy photographic grass. Keep the original small game-subject scale; no enlargement of people or buildings. Existing UI unchanged, all text retained. No additional buildings, trees or resource piles. Single complete screenshot-sized landscape study, no divided panels, no arrows, no new labels, no decorative border. This is a review paintover, not a new engine implementation.
